structured_output.what_is_happening: SRI ("Super Retarded Inu") is a 36-minute-old PumpSwap pair. GMGN shows it launched on a Meteora virtual curve, with creation and migration logged in the same second. Price went up about 530–745% in the first hour on about $2.17M of volume, which is about 37x turnover against a roughly $327K market cap at detection. It had already fallen 33–43% in the latest 5 minutes and sits about 43% below its all-time high ($0.000769 ATH vs $0.000438 now). At least 10 other tokens with the same name and ticker launched within about 40 minutes of each other. One of them shows $2.6M of hourly volume on just $96 of liquidity. The name is being mass-deployed, which suggests an external meme or trigger that the packet does not show. This contract currently has the largest market cap and liquidity of the clones.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN flags 109 bundler wallets. Unique buyers (2,152) outnumber unique sellers (153) about 14 to 1, and there were 9,601 buys. That is the typical pattern of bot-sprayed small buys or a bundle distributed across many wallets, not organic two-sided trading. The image is duplicated on 4 other tokens and GMGN recorded only 1 page visit. There are no smart-money or renowned wallets and no KOL calls. Same-second creation and migration suggests a scripted launch.
